tagline: Grounded, order-aware AI support for your store
intro: Grounded, source-cited support that takes real order actions — in 14 languages.
details: Busymate AI adds an AI support agent to your store. It answers only from your own products and policies — grounded, source-cited, and it refuses when it isn't sure — and handles WISMO plus returns, refunds and cancellations with your confirmation and a spend cap. It speaks 14 languages with auto-detect and RTL, and hands off to your team when confidence is low. You pay only for conversations it resolves — capped, and the assistant keeps working past the cap.
feature_bullets: 1-click install + auto-train on your catalog & policies
Order-aware: tracks, edits, cancels, refunds — with confirmation
Answers only from your store, with sources — grounded, cited, and refuses when unsure
Confidence-gated human handoff with clean hand-back
Pre-launch simulation on your past conversations
pricing_summary: Pay per resolved conversation. Set a monthly spend cap; the assistant keeps working past the cap.
